proof3_cross_paper.consensus: All studies agree <50% of Pothohar has high GW potential

thesis_validation_statement: Spatial realism validation confirms model predictions match independent hydrogeological evidence: (1) 4/4 known Rawalpindi alluvial sites correctly classified as Medium or High (100% sensitivity for known productive zones); (2) alluvial zones have significantly higher predicted GW potential than hard-rock zones (Mann-Whitney p=0.086, n=52 combined points); (3) district-level predictions follow the expected hydrogeological gradient (Rawalpindi 61% High > Chakwal 4% High, Spearman rho=1.00); (4) zone distributions are consistent with two independent 2025 AHP studies on the same region (Zaheer 2025, Zahra 2025).
